name: patrol2d
description: Back-and-forth movement: an entity that has a Velocity and a Patrol turns round when it reaches the end of its path. Moving platforms, guards and flying monsters need nothing else.

components.name: Patrol
components.description: Keeps the entity between min_x and max_x (when patrol_x is on) and between min_y and max_y (when patrol_y is on): when its Position goes past a limit it is put back on it and the matching speed of its Velocity changes sign. The entity's own Velocity sets how fast it goes; one that starts moving the wrong way simply turns at the first limit.

systems.name: turn
systems.description: Turns every Patrol that went past a limit round, after the movement of the tick.
